reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: exported Next.js HTTP route handler — public API exception applies. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attacker is unauthenticated external caller (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/api/ is explicitly in-scope. The handler at route.ts:12-57 returns all request cookie names (including Supabase sb-*-auth-token cookie names), oauth_redirect cookie presence flags, and x-forwarded-host/x-forwarded-proto infrastructure headers to any caller. The middleware (middleware.ts:51) marks all /api/* as isPublicPath=true, so no middleware-level auth enforcement exists. The handler never gates on getUser() result. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/auth/debug by sending an unauthenticated HTTP request, causing disclosure of all cookie names present on the request (including Supabase auth token cookie naming patterns) and infrastructure headers with no credentials required.
